recipes.title: PWM frequency & duty formula
recipes.code:
PWM_freq = TIM_CLK / ((PSC+1)*(ARR+1))
Duty% = 100 * CCR / (ARR+1)

Example: 72MHz/(72*1000)=1kHz, CCR=500 => 50%
